formula_and_interpretation.source_indicator: SFC Indicador de Calidad de Cartera por Vencimiento (ICV)
formula_and_interpretation.conceptual_formula: saldo de cartera vencida y leasing vencido / saldo de cartera bruta y leasing bruto × 100
formula_and_interpretation.housing_methodology_note: SFC methodology defines housing delinquency indicators separately for 1–4 months and >4 months; the historic workbook supplies one ICV series per modality, retained as reported without reclassification.
formula_and_interpretation.reported_value: Ratio as provided in SFC workbook; no local numerator/denominator reconstruction
formula_and_interpretation.derived_summaries: unweighted entity-level median and percentiles per modality and month

limitations: ICV is an aggregate stock ratio and does not identify borrower default probability (PD), loan transitions, or vintage performance.
Entity-level percentiles are unweighted and can change with reporting population, mergers, entries, and exits.
The historical workbook ends at 2023-12; use as a historical official benchmark, not a current monitoring feed.
Accounting/perimeter and SFC reporting changes can affect comparability; the source file does not provide point-in-time revisions.
